name: Avon Gangsters
description: Avon Gangsters (A-Block, AGS) are a Northwest Detroit street gang named after Avon Street near West Seven Mile. A hybrid set with local Crip lineage, they have been documented alongside RicoMafia/0430 and Murdaville/SellGang, and are cited as rivals of DWBI. The name A-Block is also used independently by other Detroit groups, including a SmokeCamp Bloods identifier around East Seven Mile.
